on_timeout.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the provisioning window closes.

timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: How long after boot the provisioning window stays open before closing if the device is still unprovisioned.

*See also: [Provisioning](https://esphome.io/components/provisioning#configuration-variables)*
